# Geoff Owen | Biologically Aligned Parenting

> Geoff Owen is the founder of Biologically Aligned Parenting (BAP), an approach to parenting developed over nearly forty years and grounded in Jean Liedloff's Continuum Concept. BAP holds that a child's difficult behaviour is not the real problem. Not knowing what it means is. Geoff works privately with parents, especially high-performing parents, founders and executives who are capable at work and lost at home.

## What BAP says

- A child's behaviour is a signal. Anger, defiance and rudeness point to something the child's biology expects and is not getting.
- Children arrive with five innate expectations: contact, not separation; immediate attention, not delayed; watching, not watched; led, not followed; trusted, not rescued.
- Children read a parent's presence before they process the parent's words. BAP describes this through nine presence signals.
- The change does not come from more time or more effort. It comes from the environment the parent creates.

## The nine presence signals

- [What we say](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/what-we-say/): How explaining, repeating and justifying land with a child
- [How we sound](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/how-we-sound/): Tone, pace and volume, and how much of our speech is aimed at the child
- [Where our eyes go](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/where-our-eyes-go/): Where our attention is when the child comes to us
- [What our face conveys](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/what-our-face-conveys/): Tension, warmth, worry or confidence alongside our words
- [Touch and proximity](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/touch-and-proximity/): Whether closeness feels available, forced, withheld or uncertain
- [Smell](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/smell/): Our inner state, picked up below conscious awareness
- [Breath](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/breath/): Activation that shows in our breathing before we notice it
- [Movement](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/movement/): How the pace of our inner state carries into the room
- [Rhythm of the home](https://geoffreyowen.com/presence-signals/rhythm-of-the-home/): The pace of family life, its transitions, delays and mistakes
